sum: Dhampur Bio Organics Limited has completed the slump sale of its Meerganj manufacturing unit, as disclosed to NSE on 18 June 2026.
detail: The company announced to NSE the completion of the slump sale transaction affecting the Meerganj Unit. Slump sales under Indian tax and corporate law involve transfer of a business undertaking (assets and liabilities) as a single block without itemisation. The transaction mechanics, consideration and buyer identity require corroboration from statutory filings (auditor certification, board minutes, Schedule to Balance Sheet under AS 14 / Ind AS 103 on business combinations).
